_README: Overclaim + clinical-promise guardrail. If any of these phrases appears (case-insensitive, word-boundary aware) in user-facing content strings, the content validator FAILS. This enforces the spec's non-negotiable 'no overclaiming / not a medical device' rule at author time. 'allow' entries are contexts where a banned substring is acceptable (e.g. 'therapist' inside 'not a substitute for a therapist').
